scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof of the stated finite-parameter and all-initial-state theorem is supplied, with separate exact symbolic verification and finite diagnostic code. Such checks do not replace the proof; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The boundary is sharp for the particular constructed periodic Lyapunov potential, not asserted necessary for convergence; requires a,b>0 and 0<=c<1; no quantitative attraction-basin measures or general convergence rates are claimed. A relevant 2005 predecessor was accessible only in preview; priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Sharp gradient-like boundary and global convergence for asymmetric coupled sine maps
